generationReview.actual: Seeded legal suffix-exchange walks over curated vocabulary provide inverse-reachable word targets.
generationReview.lateStageSizeBounded: Engine caps board size, graph dimension, finite horizon or physical limits; unbounded study index changes the task seed.
generationReview.initializationSampleLimit: Serialized start-state/seed variation and bounded stage dimensions only; this does not prove unique content or solvability.

distinctMechanicReview.difference: One move exchanges suffixes of two persistent pronunciation ribbons and both outputs must remain accepted words.

dynamicSamples.status: Select two persistent words and a cut after phoneme1 or2 in each. Exchange suffixes. BOTH new ribbons must be words in the visible dictionary, and the target positions matter.
